His portfolio includes the town hall and the Mauritshuis exhibition gallery in The Hague, several royal palaces and government buildings, the old town hall of Zutphen and other historical interiors with old stucco. As patron of Het Nederlandse Stucadoorsgilde, from 2001 to 2022, he taught stucco artists restoration skills, among other things. Besides lecturing, he also publishes regularly on the history of interior stucco in the Netherlands and surrounding countries
